
```jsx
import { CxToastHeader } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxToastHeader from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/toast/CxToastHeader'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the base component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **closeButton** | Automatically add a close button to the header. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
